### Chariots of Iron
Author: Justin Estrada
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/chariots-of-iron
Passage: Judges 1:19
Points:
- Judah failed to dislodge the Canaanites in the plains because the inhabitants possessed iron chariots.
- The enemy's iron technology created an overwhelming tactical advantage akin to tanks facing foot soldiers.
- Despite the daunting odds, victory was guaranteed by God's promise to fight before His people.
- Judah's retreat reflected a failure of faith rather than a limitation of God's power.
- Believers face daunting spiritual adversaries today and must resist shrinking back in fear.
- Christians can stand firm knowing Jesus has already decisively defeated the enemy.

### Bible Pathway - Mar. 22, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-22-2012.html
Passage: Judges 1:19
Points:
- Judah initially drove out mountain dwellers but stopped short when confronting iron chariots in the lowlands.
- God had specifically commanded Israel not to fear enemies with horses and chariots.
- The failure to take the valley was driven by unbelief rather than an insurmountable military force.
- Spiritual powerlessness among believers often stems from ignorance of God's Word and promises.
- Regular engagement with Scripture fuels the faith needed to overcome intimidating obstacles.
